Body & paint

Interior, wheels & tyres

  • Premium seats and floor matting

Dream mods, built where vision meets craftsmanship.

A workshop for people who love classic jeeps

On Sirsa Road in Mandi Dabwali, JC Customs takes rusted, forgotten jeeps and rebuilds them panel by panel, from bare chassis to the final coat of paint. Every build leaves the bay under a red cover and is unveiled to its owner, often with the whole family there to see it.

Buy one of our ready jeeps, or bring your own for a restoration or a custom build.
